_notes: Live labels for yz-a8c.2: family Latest CHECKED, GPT-5.6 Sol / GPT-5.5 unchecked; effort slider Pro 5 of 5 verified; closed pill '6 Pro' (effort only, no family token).
Without the isFamilyOptionLabel Latest acceptance, the reader drops the Latest radio and reports checked_count=0 on this fixture.
Account effort quota exhausted (Limit reached until 2026-10-01): all four tier rows carry aria-disabled=true + data-disabled; none is checked, so effort.label is null and effort.disabled is true.
Tier rows carry BOTH aria-label and visible text (design assumption 'aria-label only' was wrong as of this capture; isFamilyOptionLabel on text still excludes them from the family read).
Each tier row is wrapped in a tooltip <span data-state=closed>; pickerSurfaceIsOpen must not treat that wrapper as closing the row — the surface root has data-state=open.
Simple view (Power slider, 'Instant, 1 of 1.') is inert; the [role=slider] has aria-valuemin=aria-valuemax=0 and must never be read as the effort control.

Select-model toggle is inside an aria-hidden=true, inert wrapper with aria-expanded=true; ChatGPT now persists the expanded state, so the collapsed shape from 2026-09-01 is no longer reproducible on this account.
